title: How ChatGPT Took Over the Internet
description:
ChatGPT has taken the world by storm, but what exactly is it? This video explains how OpenAI’s ChatGPT works, its history from GPT-1 to GPT-3, and why it’s often compared to Google. We explore how this AI chatbot generates human-like text, its applications in customer service, coding, translation, and summarization, and the problems it faces like bias, misinformation, and limits on creativity.

From Elon Musk’s early involvement in OpenAI to the breakthroughs that made GPT-3 viral with over a million users in just a week, this is the story of how ChatGPT became a global phenomenon. If you’ve searched for what is ChatGPT, how ChatGPT works, ChatGPT vs Google, OpenAI Elon Musk Sam Altman, future of AI chatbots, or will AI replace humans, this video gives you the rational perspective.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations!

Chapters with Timestamps

00:00 – What is ChatGPT? Introduction
03:00 – OpenAI: from Elon Musk to Sam Altman
06:40 – How ChatGPT generates human-like text
10:20 – Evolution from GPT-1 to GPT-3
14:00 – ChatGPT vs Google: different strengths
17:30 – Applications in chatbots, coding & translation
21:00 – Can ChatGPT replace humans? Limitations explained
25:00 – The future of AI and ChatGPT
